title: Density Formula
text: Density is mass per unit volume: $$\rho=\frac{m}{V}, $$ where $$\rho$$ is the density, $$m$$ is the mass, and $$V$$ is the volume occupied by the substance.

title: Identify the Density of Gasoline
text: The density of gasoline is approximately $$680\,\text{kg/m}**3$$.

title: Volume Formula for a Rectangular Prism
text: The volume of a rectangular tank is its length times its width times its depth: $$V=lwd$$.
